Our journey

Small beginnings. Unforgettable memories.

What started in 2019 with just ₹1,100 and a small gang became a journey we will always remember. We learned by doing, improved our arrangements year after year, and kept coming back because the real value was never only in the celebration. It was in the people who stood beside us, the families who supported us, and the memories we created together. Every year became another chapter in the story of TYC.

The timeline

Every year tells a story.

Choose the correct photo in each year’s box to preview it on the page.

2019

The beginning ❤️

Every great journey starts somewhere, and ours began with a small gang and just ₹1,100. We didn't have a huge budget or a big setup, but we had excitement, dedication and full energy. We put our hearts into the celebration and learned how much can be achieved when a few people share the same goal. The first year gave TYC its foundation and memories that remind us how far a small beginning can take us.

2020

Growing through support

In our second year, the budget and arrangements improved, and we started understanding how to plan a celebration properly. The support we received mainly came from our family, and that support mattered more than words can say. It gave us confidence to keep going, manage what we had, and make the best of every resource. 2020 taught us that progress isn't only about having more people around; sometimes the support of a few people who truly believe in you is enough.

2021

A little better, a little stronger

The third year was a small but meaningful improvement over the second. We learned from earlier experiences, noticed what worked, and thought about how to make things better. Each arrangement and shared responsibility helped us grow. It wasn't about suddenly becoming the biggest committee; it was about moving one step forward and keeping our spirit alive. 2021 reminded us that steady progress deserves to be celebrated too, because every improvement becomes part of the foundation for the years that follow.

2022

The turning point ⚡

Our fourth year felt like a turning point. The energy grew, more people joined the gang, and teamwork gave the celebration a different momentum. We had more hands to help, more enthusiasm to share and a stronger feeling that we were building something together. This year became one of the most memorable steps in our journey. 2022 gave TYC fresh confidence and encouraged us to aim higher while remembering where we started.

2023

The blockbuster year 🔥

The fifth year became a blockbuster chapter for TYC. Enthusiasm, teamwork and continued support helped us make the celebration feel bigger and more special. Everyone's contribution mattered, whether they helped with arrangements, brought ideas, shared the workload or simply brought positive energy. Looking back, this year stands out as a moment when our efforts came together. It showed us that the strongest part of a celebration isn't just what people see; it's the team spirit working behind the scenes.

2024

A pause, not the end

In 2024, we couldn't hold our celebration because of 10th-class school timings and the responsibilities that came with that stage of life. It was a pause in the calendar, not an end to our bond. Studies had to come first, and that was part of growing up. Even without a celebration that year, the previous memories remained with us and the idea of coming together again stayed alive. Our journey has never been only about an annual event; it has also been about the friendships that remain when plans change.

No celebration in 2024 — a pause before the next chapter.
2025

Reunited again 🤝

In 2025, we came together again and brought the TYC spirit back to life. After a year away from celebrations, reuniting felt special. We had grown and our lives had moved forward, but the excitement of making memories together was still there. It was a good celebration built on familiar faces, renewed energy and the bond we had kept. This year reminded us that time apart doesn't erase what a team has built. Sometimes, coming back together is a memory in itself—and a fresh start for the years ahead.

2026

The bond continues 🧡

2026 carried the same togetherness and spirit that made 2025 special. We continued our journey, celebrated together and added another chapter to the TYC story. The years have changed and the memories have become more meaningful, but the heart of the committee remains the same: devotion, teamwork, family support and friendship. From the first ₹1,100 celebration to today, the real achievement is not a number or a single event. It's the journey we have shared and the memories still waiting to be made.

Our people

One team. One family.

Behind every celebration are people who give it meaning. This journey belongs to every member and every family that stood with TYC.
